payload.claim: The docstring claims 'All three read a recorded spec text,' but only the third case (`record_text=inline_text`, case_c) ever calls `ledger.record_spec_text`. Cases A and B call `_run` with no `record_text` argument, so `ledger.spec_text(task_id)` returns `None` for them and `_spec_for_task` (saffron/commit_review.py:126-134) falls back to reading the spec file at the base export, not a recorded spec text. 'Recorded spec text' is a defined term (a task-recorded text that is specifically not the one at `base_sha`), so this sentence misstates what two of the three cases actually exercise.
